[red bold]-- DEVICE PIN ERROR -- main.volt:5[/red bold]

`NRF24L01` needs pins cs, ce. Missing: cs, ce.

 [dim]4 |[/dim]     bus spi0: SPI(sck: 18, mosi: 23, miso: 19)
 [dim]5 |[/dim]     device nrf24l01: NRF24L01 on spi0 at 5
 [dim]  |[/dim] [red]           ^^^^^^^^[/red]

[cyan]Hint: `device nrf24l01: NRF24L01(cs: <gpio>, ce: <gpio>)`[/cyan]
